dz: 根据Ptolemy的说法,纳博纳萨尔纪元(英语:Nabonassar Era)的发源地从这一天的正午开始. 历史学家用这个来确立现代BC编年史,用于约会历史事件.
de: According to Ptolemy, the epoch (origin) of the Nabonassar Era began at noon on this date. Historians use this to establish the modern BC chronology for dating historic events.
